verses.1: For in those days and at that time, when I restored the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.2: And I will bring all the nations and the foreigners down to the edge of judgment. There, I will judge them along with their people. My land, Israel, will be restored to me, as it was once lost among the nations.
verses.3: And to my people, they gave birth to children. The boy was given away as a gift, and the girl was sold in the market. They were married off.
verses.4: And also, what do you have for me as a punishment? All the paths of Philistia are yours. You take over everything from me. But if you try to take over me, I will quickly restore your kingdom back to its original state.
verses.5: May your money and gold be taken away from me, but may my best gifts be brought to you.
verses.6: And the sons of Judah and the sons of Jerusalem sold them to the people of Yehuva, so that they could be driven away from their borders.
verses.7: I am coming from the place where you bought them. I will return to you with your heads in my hands.
verses.8: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into slavery to the children of Judah. They will be taken away as slaves to distant lands, because the LORD has said so.
verses.9: Read this in the nations. They were sanctified by war. The rulers will come and all the people who fought in that war will rise up.
verses.10: Let them destroy your songs and your dances. The weak will say, “I am a king.”
verses.11: All the nations around them came and attacked them. But the throne of Jehovah was protected by your strength.
verses.12: The nations will be brought forth and raised to the heights of Yehoshafat. There, fire will be kindled to judge all the nations from every direction.
verses.13: Send out the scouts, for the harvest is near. Come down quickly, for the grain has been filled. Open the bins, for their suffering is great.
verses.14: The days are long and endless in the wilderness, for the day of Jehovah is near in the wilderness.
verses.15: The sun and the stars rose, and the clouds gathered together.
verses.16: And Jehovah will sound his voice from Zion, and from Jerusalem he will bring judgment. He will make the heavens and the earth hear his voice. And Jehovah will protect His people and save the children of Israel.
verses.17: Know that I, Jehovah your God, dwell in the Holy Mountain. Jerusalem shall remain holy forever; foreigners will not be allowed to enter it anymore.
verses.18: And on that day, the mountains would be covered with foam; rivers of milk would flow down from them. All the streams of Judah would flow from God’s house, and they would fill up the river Shittim.
verses.19: From Egypt to the Sinai Peninsula, there will be no more destruction. The Sinai Peninsula will be freed from the oppression of the descendants of Judah, who spilled blood in their own land.
verses.20: And Judah shall dwell forever, and Jerusalem shall remain a place of peace for generations to come.
verses.21: And I will take blood, without taking it. And Jehovah shall be in Zion.
